title: Preserve explicit daemon index destinations across workspace aliases
outcome: Identical explicit database destinations derive the same canonical daemon key when the same physical workspace is reached through lexical or junction/symlink root spellings.
acceptance: A regression using one explicit absolute database path across a physical workspace root and its junction/symlink alias derives one key and the live handshake joins one daemon.
The original Codex and Claude reviewers verify the final packet with no unresolved Critical or High finding.

completion.summary: Canonicalized explicit daemon index destinations through the nearest existing physical ancestor, closing both workspace-alias path directions without creating the destination parent.
